description.text: The sixth Scarlet & Violet set, released on 24 May 2024 with 226 cards: 167 and 59 secret rares. It brought in the Pokémon of Kitakami, led by the masked Legendary Ogerpon as Tera Pokémon ex of four types, with Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex and Sinistcha ex, while Greninja, Dragapult and Magcargo appear as Tera Pokémon ex. It has more ACE SPEC cards.

description.text: The Champion copy of Community Center, stamped for the winner of a Professor Cup. Professor Cups are fun-format tournaments held through the year for Pokémon Professors, usually those at Stage 1 and above. Community Center became the Professor Cup promo at the Cup held during Professor Conference 2024 in Mexico City, and it was the first to have a Top 4 stamp; it came in five versions, regular, Staff, Top 8, Top 4 and Champion.
